snippet.title: Castlevania Remembrance 0.5.0 - Fangame Trailer
snippet.description:
First public release of the Castlevania project I am currently developing since September 2024. Re-discover some of the most memorable aspects of all 3 DSVanias in this roguelike fangame built from the ground up in UE5.
More content is planned to be added in the future as per the roadmap displayed on Github.

All code was 100% written by hand, AI has only been used for occasional guidance and to draw the subtitle letters of the game's logo.

Download link:
https://github.com/Lakifume/CVR/releases/latest

Discord link available from the title screen
